description: We had a lively discussion at the Monday, August 17 Right Thinkers meeting in Olean, joined by Attorney General candidate Saritha Komatireddy and Assemblyman Joe Sempolinski, to talk about the damage one-party rule has done to New York. The facts are sobering. We now have the third-highest electricity prices in the nation, due to Democrats’ reckless climate agenda. Crime is up 23% since bail reform was implemented (don’t believe the governor’s cherry-picked stats). Rampant Medicaid fraud Albany

title: Senator George Borrello Joins AG Candidate Saritha Komatireddy and Assemblyman Sempolinski for Right Thinkers Meeting in Olean
